tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Upgrade your power connectivity with the Well Shin WS-156 Adapter Plug, This premium-quality adapter allows you to convert a European plug (Schuko/CEE-7) into a NEMA 5-15R connector (USA standard) safely and efficiently.


Ideal for use in Bangladesh, offices, data centers, and industrial applications, this adapter plug supports up to 10 Amps at 250 Volts, ensuring reliable current flow for your devices. Its compact design, durable construction, and secure fit make it a must-have for anyone dealing with international power connections.


Key Features:


  • Converts European plug to NEMA 5-15R (3-pin US connector)
  • Rated voltage: 250V, Rated current: 10A
  • Premium Well Shin Taiwan build quality
  • Durable and safe design with secure plug fit
  • Compact, lightweight, and travel-friendly
  • Ideal for international device connections in Bangladesh


Applications:


Perfect for laptops, desktop computers, network equipment, and electrical appliances that require US-type connection using a European plug source.
